author: Veronica Rodriguez
developer_reply:
Good morning Veronica! You can cancel your subscription in Google Play:
1. Tap on your profile icon located at the top right corner of the screen.
2. Select Payments & subscriptions.
3. Choose the subscription you want to cancel from the list.
4. Tap on Cancel subscription.
5. Follow the instructions to confirm the cancellation.
Have a great week!

text: O aplicativo é bom, tem boas funcionalidades, e um ótimo visual. Infelizmente a sincronização deixa bastante a desejar.
